title: Custom eggless birthday cakes for Granville and Merrylands families
summary:
A birthday cake for a Granville or Merrylands party still comes with one question first: does it actually have no eggs in it? At Num Nums the answer is the same for every cake, every time — yes.

We've been 100% eggless since 2019. Not eggless by request. Eggless by default. Six sizes from 6-inch to 16-inch, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, any design you send us. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Pickup from Wigram Street, Harris Park — under 10 minutes from Granville and Merrylands, open until 10pm daily. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
